impact.text: Direct theft of residual ETH and/or ERC20 stuck/dusted in router, independent of user mistakes.

precondition_sources.text: The router holds nonzero residual ETH and/or ERC20 funds accumulated via receive(), injectSweepAndCall pulls, unrefunded overpaid ETH, or target returns.
TrailsRouter's execute and pullAmountAndExecute entrypoints are publicly callable.

intent_sources.text: Value forwarded by the router must equal msg.value, with no access to the existing router balance.
